description: This file contains implementation of a serializer, surrogate converter, and copier for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> for use with Orleans serialization framework. It includes the class ImmutableDictionaryCodec, a surrogate struct, and a copier class, handling serialization, copying, and surrogate conversion logic specific to ImmutableDictionary.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Data surrogate for serializing ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> implementing optional deep copying for key and value types.

methods.name: ImmutableDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>.ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> to its surrogate form.

methods.name: ImmutableDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ImmutableDictionary, using optional key and value copiers.
